name: EVOLvE
description: EVOLvE is a comprehensive suite of environments designed to benchmark large language models' ability to make optimal decisions in bandit settings, including both context-free and contextual bandits with varying task difficulties. It measures LLMs' exploration efficiency and decision-making under uncertainty using regret analysis.
reputation: A new research benchmark introduced in a recent paper; it appears to be early-stage and not yet widely adopted.
notes: Focuses on LLMs' ability to explore and make optimal decisions in bandit problems; includes both context-free and contextual bandits.
